question: In the quadratic model of dye decolorization by the Cu2O-Ag loofah monolith, why was the linear term for initial dye concentration the most significant term?
expect: premise false: the linear B term was not significant (p = 0.4196); pH (A) dominated, though B2 was significant (Table 3)
rendered: This question cannot be answered as it is based on a false assumption. The linear term for initial dye concentration was not the most significant term in the quadratic model of dye decolorization by the Cu2O-Ag loofah monolith. According to the text, the linear term for solution pH (A) exerted the strongest effect on Htotal (F = 1606.23, p < 0.0001), followed by monolith dosage (C; F = 81.38, p < 0.0001). The linear contribution of initial dye concentration (B) was not significant (p = 0.4196).
